newsitem.title: USA: Lucent rises after contract announcement.
newsitem.headline: Lucent rises after contract announcement.

text.p: Shares of Lucent Technologies Inc rose on Thursday in heavy trading.
Shares rose 1 to 48-3/8 with over two million shares changing hands in early afternoon trading.
Earlier, Lucent said it won a $71 million contract to supply and install a wireless network to Shinsegi Telecomm Inc, a Korean phone service providers.

The network will cover the areas of Pusan and Kyungnam, which are located in the south, Lucent said, and Shinsegi plans to expand its service network to cover the entire country by the end of the year.
